sentence: This project creates reagents that correct gene mutations causing cystic fibrosis in cells lining the airways of a large animal model.
This project looks for genes that change the course of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and related motor neuron diseases.
This project builds a deep learning method that predicts how different treatments would work for each individual patient.
This project tests parts of an outpatient care package to find the combination that reduces suicidal thoughts and behaviors in youth.
This project tests a measure of how adolescents and their caregivers vaguely disclose suicidal intent without stating it outright.
This project uses in situ bioprinting of stem cells to build vascularized bone tissue for bone injuries that will not heal on their own.
This project develops computational techniques that predict how anesthetic drugs change brain activity in individual patients with treatment-resistant depression.
This project uses artificial intelligence to find features of e-cigarette social media posts that get high user engagement.
This project trains large language models to extract key data from pathology reports of breast cancer and gastric cancer.
This project develops MRI methods that use deep learning to handle patient motion so pediatric scans work without anesthesia.
This project studies how the immune system recognizes and responds to commensal microbes to protect against intestinal inflammation.
This project studies how signaling proteins form and work, and how they help keep iron balanced in the body.
This project builds a data system that gathers and compares molecular data from marmosets and humans to study Alzheimer’s disease.
This project builds an artificial intelligence tool that combines clinical reports, MRI and ultrasound images to target prostate cancer biopsies.
This project builds reporter mouse models to find which proteins specific cell types secrete to drive systemic inflammation.
This project studies how amyloid-beta changes the structure and function of different synapses in the brain in Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies the genes and clinical features of children with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder compared with matched controls.
This project studies how innate immune activation drives cells to copy immune-related genes and make extrachromosomal DNA.
